homogeneous_closure_false.reason: E(t) ~ Ct^2 near t=0 gives E'/E ~ 2/t -> infinity
homogeneous_closure_false.consequence: No homogeneous energy estimate E' <= CE at critical exponent
homogeneous_closure_false.note: The (2p-n)=0 cancellation concerns only constant homothety, not spatial Hessian

deturck_pullback.standard_ricci_flow: phi^* Ric(ghat) = Ric(phi^* ghat), so pullback works
deturck_pullback.conclusion: DeTurck pullback gives transported-cutoff flow, not fixed-cutoff flow
deturck_pullback.fix: Need coupled system: (ghat, ahat=a o phi^{-1}) with ahat transport equation

coupled_system_assessment.metric_equation: Xu-type with coefficient ahat (not fixed a)
coupled_system_assessment.scalar_equation: dt ahat = ahat W(ahat), first-order transport by DeTurck field
coupled_system_assessment.main_difficulty: ahat degenerates (-> 0 at support boundary) and evolves
coupled_system_assessment.plausibility: standard coupled parabolic-transport theory applies in principle, but the degenerate coefficient evolution must be handled explicitly
coupled_system_assessment.status: NOT yet proved; requires new coupled fixed-point argument

negative_chain_status.A1_start: NOT proved. Coupled system (5.2) is the correct target.
negative_chain_status.A2_first_exit: Cannot verify without A1. Genuine cutoff forcing invalidates Step51's homogeneous L^p closure.
negative_chain_status.A4_continuation: Separate from start; shifted T/U/C may survive independently.
negative_chain_status.overall: The negative chain breaks at A1 (start module). The coupled metric-transport system is the correct repair target. This is a non-trivial extension of Xu/Yang but structurally plausible.

critical_product_analysis.bar_beta_scaling: O(A^{1/2}) for IL family with topological parameter A
critical_product_analysis.yang_threshold: c(4)^{-1} is a universal constant, so threshold may be exceeded for large A
critical_product_analysis.fixed_topology: All constants finite; per-manifold theorem with delta_0 ~ c/sqrt(A)
critical_product_analysis.metric_comparison_constraint: delta_0 <= c/sqrt(A) from metric drift integral
critical_product_analysis.uniform_gap: NO uniform gap across IL family (delta_0 -> 0 as A -> infinity)
critical_product_analysis.per_manifold_gap: YES, delta_0(M) > 0 for each fixed M, if start+H2 proved
